prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 36-year-old amateur female runner with a short blonde ponytail and a flushed ordinary face crosses a simple unprinted finish ribbon at a small park race. Her 39-year-old clean-shaven partner with glasses waits beyond it with an encouraging smile and open bent arms. Capture her tired joyful expression, believable running posture and feet, in clean morning light; no sponsor signs or race numbers. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Wide horizontal 16:9 section composition. Keep all main faces, important hands and the complete action safely inside both central 4:3 and 1.65:1 crops, with natural environmental margins. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional anatomy and composition requirements: The runner wears a plain muted green running top and practical dark running shorts, no bib or lettering. Show the thin unprinted white ribbon contacting and parting at her waist as she passes through it, with physically plausible loose ends. Her arms remain naturally bent near her torso, one foot firmly landing and the other lifting in a believable running stride. Her partner stands to the side just beyond her, not blocking her path. Keep her whole body, ribbon contact and partner compactly inside both central safe crops, with generous park space at both edges. No repeated limbs, merged fingers, floating feet or twisted knees.
review: Reviewed wide race photo: blonde amateur runner crosses a plain white ribbon at waist height, one foot landing and the other lifted in a believable stride. Clean-shaven partner waits off her path with open hands. Runner face, hands, legs and ribbon contact clear; partner face/hands stay within central crops, no numbers or logos, continuous natural park scene.
